page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz with a 35 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or hardware GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge sits primarily in the lower performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench rank in the bottom 10% to 25%. Memory bandwidth read-only tests are also weak, though large-block write operations achieve average tier results. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as gzip compression, show poor performance, while Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests reach average levels. LLM inference speeds are average for small 135M models but drop to poor for larger 7B models.

Given its dedicated core allocation and high memory capacity paired with older-generation Intel Cascade Lake architecture, this instance offers a cost-effective entry point for memory-intensive workloads that do not require peak CPU compute speeds. It is suitable for hosting medium-sized databases, memory-caching layers like Redis with moderate throughput requirements, and general-purpose enterprise applications needing a larger memory footprint without the premium cost of newer hardware generations.
